headline: Scandi Standard Shares Fall After Portuguese Investor Grupo Lusiaves Cuts Stake
summary: Shares in Swedish poultry producer Scandi Standard declined after Portuguese investor Grupo Lusiaves sold 28,000 shares for 5.6 million kronor.
why: Scandi Standard is the largest chicken provider in the Nordic region, listed on Nasdaq Stockholm.

impacts.name: Scandi Standard
impacts.why: Scandi Standard stock fell after major shareholder Grupo Lusiaves trimmed its equity position.
